active_loop.feedback: Reveal frozen labels batchwise, refit from scratch on all screened rows, query highest-scoring remaining rows.
active_loop.ties: Stable descending score over canonical ascending record-identity order.

arms.R0_L1: candidate representation plus V4-selected L1 learner/balancer

decision_rule: CANNOT_CHECK if M1 or M2 fails. The mechanism-transport positive terminal requires M1-M6. Otherwise retain every measured effect and use the adverse mechanism terminal. Report preserved G1-G6 separately; they cannot be relaxed or used to promote an arm.

estimands.full_arm_candidate_minus_u4: R0_L0-R1_L1, review-level and unweighted mean for preserved V3 gates.
estimands.learner_balancer_main_effect: Review-level average of (R0_L1-R0_L0) and (R1_L1-R1_L0), then unweighted mean across five reviews.
estimands.representation_main_effect: Review-level average of (R1_L0-R0_L0) and (R1_L1-R0_L1), then unweighted mean.

forbidden_claims: statistical independence beyond the enforced content-identity rule

initialization.rule: Within each class and review choose the row minimizing SHA-256(review, NUL, record identity); positive first, negative second.

L1.balancer: positive weight 1; negative weight positives/(9.8*negatives); normalize mean one

mechanism_gates.M1_BINDING: Every source, rights, selection, population, protocol and implementation hash passes.
mechanism_gates.M2_CONTENT_DISJOINT_POPULATION: Exactly 101044 canonical rows; zero SWIFT overlap and zero pairwise successor overlap; all five reviews retained and both label classes present.
mechanism_gates.M3_LEARNER_RECALL10_MAGNITUDE: Unweighted mean learner/balancer R@10 effect >= 0.010858985820770889 (max of 0.01 and half absolute V3 full-arm gap).
mechanism_gates.M4_LEARNER_RECALL10_SIGN: Learner/balancer R@10 effect is strictly positive in at least four of five reviews.
mechanism_gates.M5_LEARNER_WORK_SAVING: Unweighted mean learner/balancer WSS@95 effect is nonnegative.
mechanism_gates.M6_LEARNER_HARM: Worst review learner/balancer R@10 effect is at least -0.05.

nonpromotion_rule: No V5 arm replaces the candidate or supports superiority. A positive terminal confirms only directional transport of the V4 learner/balancer component attribution under this exact source and adapter.
